text.en: This Order may be cited as the Constitution (Transfer of Functions Citation and and Consequential Provisions) Order, 1992 and shall be deemed to have Commencecome into force on 20th day of January, 1992. ment.
In this Order, "functions" includes any powers, duties, privileges or Interpretabenefits conferred or imposed by any written law on any person or auth-tion. ority.
